0.note: Horizontal total. Value write must land exactly on a CRTC char boundary: 96c (start of the 32c right-hand segment) or 0/128c (start of scanline). hsync (R2=95) only fires when R0>=95.

4.note: Vertical total (rows-1). R4=0 => 1 row per micro-frame for the RVI trick.

9.note: Scanlines per row. R9 = this_line + 15 - next_line. Must be set before the row ends.

12.note: Screen start address high. Latched at end of row (C4=R4). Must be set before row ends.

13.note: Screen start address low. Latched at end of row. Must be set before row ends.
